messages:
maria: Quick sweep before the catalog launch — need a status check on the new open variants we ingested yesterday. Who's owning final license text and perf profile vetting?

ben: I'm tracking perf profiles. Two models still failing 95th perc latency on A10s. Investigating batch size/prefill. PR with perf artifacts: https://git.internal.redwood/pr/482

alex: I'll look into the A10 tail latency, but need the exact requests distribution. ben can you paste the sample histogram?

ben: pasted small snippet:
```json
{"seq_dist": "mostly short: 8-64", "p95": 320, "p99": 780}
```

elaine: I have a redline on model-x license (non-commercial clause). Can't clear until we get a response from upstream. Sent email to maintainer. ETA 48h.

maria: OK — can product still ship catalog with that model gated? We need owners for rollout policy.

srini: We can ship without model-x; mark it as 'preview' and make it opt-in in the catalog. Owner: @ben to follow.

ben: Ack. I'll add metadata flag and a canary rollout. Will open PR for catalog metadata: #487.

sam: Ping on code review for the ingest job — blocked by config change in infra. @alex any ETA?

alex: Config change merged to staging; deploy scheduled at 09:30 PT. After that ingest job can be retried with:
```bash
./tools/ingest_model.sh --model-id model-x --variant open-v2 --profile perf-202603
```

catalog-bot: ingest job queued (job id 3429). :white_check_mark:

maria: Good. Action items:
- ben: perf investigation + PR #487 (owner)
- alex: infra deploy + confirm ingest success
- elaine: license follow-up (48h)
- srini: update release notes to mark model-x preview

ben: noted. will update thread when PR green.

alex: will post logs after deploy.

elaine: filed follow-up, cc'd compliance.

maria: thanks all. If no blockers by EOD we'll proceed with catalog cut tomorrow. :rocket:
